subj: LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION FOR SERGEANT J. M. OKAFOR

paragraphs.text: It is my distinct honor and privilege to recommend Sergeant Okafor for MECEP.
Sergeant Okafor is an outstanding Marine with a take charge attitude who has been the heart and soul of the section since her arrival. She is truly among the best I have served with.
She has completed numerous courses and has consistently gone above and beyond in every task assigned, despite a difficult family situation and a medical setback she overcame.
I have no doubt she will excel as an officer.
Please contact me with any questions.
